name: tasktrace-mcp
description: Gives Codex access to your own work history. Ask 'what did I do today', 'find when I worked on billing', or 'what do I know about OAuth' — Codex reads your TaskTrace activity and knowledge graph locally through an MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Your own work history as context for Codex
interface.longDescription: Connects the local TaskTrace desktop app to Codex as an MCP server. Codex can ask questions like 'what did I do today', 'find when I worked on billing', 'what am I typing right now', or 'what do I know about OAuth refresh flows', and get answers from your recent activity, screenshots, transcripts, and knowledge graph. All data stays on your machine; you choose which feeds to share from TaskTrace's Preferences > MCP pane.
defaultPrompt: Use TaskTrace to answer questions about my own work history, in-progress tasks, and personal knowledge graph. Run tasktrace_search for historical questions and read the active-day resources when I ask about today.
